exposure: gestational diabetes mellitus (diagnosed using WHO 2013 criteria vs WHO 1999 criteria)
outcome: maternal complications (polyhydramnios, pregnancy-induced hypertension, preterm delivery)
cohort: 613 Omani women at the Bawshar Specialized Polyclinic in Muscat, Oman, between January and December 2016
finding: The incidence of GDM among Omani women was significantly higher when using the latest WHO diagnostic criteria (48.5%) compared to previous criteria (26.4%), and there was a slight increase in the frequency of maternal and neonatal complications using the newer criteria.
